messages:
alex_dev: Quick sync — drafting PRD acceptance criteria for SLO/SLA. Need explicit handling for odd load shapes: short high-QPS bursts, long-context requests (16k+), embedding bulk jobs, and cold-KV-cache spikes. I sketched thresholds below.

maria_pm: Thanks. Can we make the thresholds concrete? Product needs clear go/no-go for launch.

sam_sre: Proposal:
- p50 <= 60ms
- p95 <= 180ms
- p99 <= 600ms (streaming allowed up to 1s tail)
- Error rate (5xx + client timeouts) <= 0.2% per day
- Error budget: 0.5% monthly

Also add separate SLO for long-context (>8k): p95 <= 800ms, p99 <= 2s

jen_product: Acceptance gates:
1) Canary: 1000 reqs over 1h with no SLO breaches
2) Load test with synthetic burst: 10k rps for 5s sustained, tail p99 under 1.5x baseline
3) Regression tests with customer prompt set — 0 functional regressions

kai_infra: For graceful degradation, fallback policy options:
- route to smaller model (quantized) if queue > 200ms
- return truncated/partial response with header: X-Partial-Response: true
- enqueue and notify caller with 202 + async callback when done
Example routing rule:
```
if queue_ms > 200:
  route -> model:rw-7b-quant
  header: X-Degraded: 'model-7b-quant'
```

sam_sre: Edge cases — noisy neighbor: ensure per-tenant concurrency limit and fair share. Add KV-cache warmup test: cold-cache p99 allowed up to 3x baseline for first 30s of load, but must reach steady SLO within 2 minutes.

maria_pm: Who owns the canary script and the customer prompt set?

alex_dev: devex will own canary + harness. @jen_product please finalize customer prompt set; we'll version it in evals repo.

deploy-bot: Synthetic run 1988-03-12T11:03:00Z: burst test simulated — initial p99=1.6s, improved to 580ms after batching tuning. :chart_with_upwards_trend: \n
jen_product: OK — next steps: write the PRD acceptance checklist with these exact numbers, link to canary harness, and add rollback thresholds (>=3 SLO breaches in 1h -> automatic rollback). I'll draft today.

sam_sre: +1. Also add alerting: burn-rate alerts at 3x for 1h and paging policy.

alex_dev: Great. I'll update the RFC with these acceptance criteria and ping for review. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
